result.summary: Removes a legacy locale initialization workaround from common system initialization code. The workaround is no longer required because Bitcoin Core has replaced Boost.Filesystem with std::filesystem, which does not inspect the environment locale on POSIX systems.
result.problem: The codebase retained legacy locale checks originally introduced to avoid exceptions from Boost.Filesystem under invalid environment locales. This workaround is obsolete and created platform-specific friction on operating systems like illumos (attempted to be patched in PR #36399).
evidence: PR description: 'This was added to work around boost::filesystem throwing when the environments locale was invalid. Boost.Filesystem has been removed, and std::filesystem doesn't use the locale on POSIX'
PR description notes it serves as an alternative to PR #36399 ('common: Skip environment locale check on illumos'), which attempted to extend the hack.
result.card: Removes an obsolete environment locale validation workaround from common startup code. The workaround originally existed to prevent Boost.Filesystem from throwing exceptions when encountering invalid locales, but Bitcoin Core now uses std::filesystem. Removing the hack avoids maintaining platform-specific workarounds (such as an illumos-specific patch proposed in PR #36399).

risk.why: Unintended behavior changes could cause startup crashes or string encoding issues on platforms with invalid or unconventional locale environments.
